description: Agent IP Records: submit an IP portfolio with the application, registration and docket records it answers to: the owner with its reference and name; each portfolio asset with its id, reference, kind (trademark or patent), the mark or invention title, the application or registration number, the owner it lists and its status; each application record with its id, serial number, kind, title, applicant, the moment filed and its status; each registration or granted patent with its id, number, the application serial it issued from, kind, title, the owner the register records, the moment registered and its status; each docket entry with its id, number and status. The signed report gives the owner and the assets, each asset against the application or registration record behind it, each registration on record against the portfolio, each asset’s owner against the owner the office records, and each asset’s status across the portfolio, the office record and the docket, and counts them, and names divergent IP portfolio records: an asset the portfolio lists with no application or registration record behind it, a registration on record that the portfolio does not list, an owner name that differs between the portfolio and the register records, and an asset whose status the records disagree on; then a docket entry naming a number no asset, application or registration holds and a mark or title unlike the office record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No assets, no application or registration records beside the assets, or an asset with no number leaves those points unverified. Numbers match by letters and digits, so 97/123,456 and 97123456 are one serial number, an asset matches a registration by its own number or the application it issued from, owners compare without case, punctuation or company endings, an asset with no owner of its own reads under the portfolio owner, marks and titles compare by their words without case or the registration signs, and statuses compare as written. This reads the portfolio as a whole against the office records behind every trademark and patent it lists. Verdict ip_portfolio_divergent, ip_portfolio_partial, ip_portfolio_unverified or ip_portfolio_consistent. POST /api/ip-portfolio-check. Reads the intellectual property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no application, pays no fee, contacts no patent or trademark office or attorney and gives no legal advice, which stay with the owner, its IP counsel and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent IP Records reads a business’s own intellectual property records: trademark and patent application records, registration records, prosecution and office-action records, renewal and maintenance records, assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, license records, use and specimen records and docket records, each against the application, registration and docket records, the filing receipts and exhibits on file, the responses and the portfolio, the registrations, the register’s chain of title, the register records, the use records or the matters and filings on record. The family’s ground is the office record behind the brand and the invention: what was applied for, what registered, who the register says owns it, and whether the deadlines and licenses hold up; the Agent Legal family reads the contracts parties sign, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-ip-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-ip-records/.
